prompt: Create a vertical photorealistic fashion-editorial image in a minimalist studio with a smooth light gray wall and concrete floor, lit by warm sunlight casting sharp rectangular window shadows from the left. On the left side, show a real young woman with dark brown to black hair wearing an oversized blue-and-white Japanese wave-pattern kimono jacket, short black shorts, white crew socks, and chunky white platform sneakers. She has visible black line tattoos on both legs and wears a bulky black futuristic VR headset with small antenna-like wires and mechanical attachments. Pose her standing on one leg with her left knee raised, one arm curved gracefully above her head and the other hand held in front of her chest like a dancer. On the right side, directly on the wall, draw a large black marker manga-style sketch of an energetic anime version of the same character, about the same height as the real woman, wearing a similar patterned kimono, sneakers, leg tattoos, and a cartoon VR headset with antennae. The drawn character should be jumping with one arm stretched high, one leg kicked back, open smiling mouth, big sparkling eyes, flowing hair, exaggerated motion lines, and decorative doodles. Include exactly 2 main figures: 1 photorealistic woman and 1 black line-art anime wall drawing. Include exactly 4 decorative doodle symbols around the drawing: 1 large star, 1 heart, and 2 small stars. Use a playful mixed-media concept where reality blends into hand-drawn imagination, with crisp ink lines, no color in the drawing, no text, no logos, and no watermark. The overall mood is stylish, inventive, cyberpunk-meets-Japanese-streetwear, with a clean high-resolution editorial composition.

promptZh: 创作一张融合了漫画线条艺术的竖版时尚大片。一位身材苗条的年轻女性，年轻日本女性，站在左侧，背景是简约的浅灰色混凝土摄影棚墙面和地面，柔和的自然光透过窗户投下斜向的阴影。她身穿一件超大号蓝白相间的和服式羽织，内搭短款束腰套装，脚穿白色中筒袜和厚底白色运动鞋。她露出的腿部有黑色纹身图案。她佩戴着一个笨重的黑色未来感 VR 头显，上面带有细小的电线和机械附件，深色长发披散在肩头。她的一只膝盖高高抬起，仿佛正在跳舞，一只手臂优雅地举过头顶，另一只手臂弯曲横在胸前，姿态极具风格。在墙的右侧，绘制一个与该角色真人大小相当的黑色墨水漫画涂鸦，充满活力且俏皮，夸张的闪亮双眼透过卡通 VR 头显清晰可见，头发上别着天线发卡，长发飘逸，张嘴微笑，身上的和服也以细腻的黑色线条呈现。插画角色正在跳跃，一只手臂向上伸展，一条腿向后弯曲，另一条腿向下延伸，与真人模特的活力相呼应。在插画周围包含 4 组装饰性涂鸦：上方一个五角星，上方一个爱心，三组动感线条，以及右下角脚部附近两颗小星星。保持真人部分为照片级逼真效果，漫画角色为平面的单色手绘墨水风格，如同直接在墙上绘制而成。使用 深钴蓝色 作为服装的主色调，保持极简背景，高细节，焦点清晰，阴影真实，无标题，无水印。
